title: The Pedigree Embryo Vault
logline: An orbital cattle herder discovers a livestock syndicate substituted degraded synthetic stock for certified dairy lineages to conceal a catastrophic cryogenic failure before the annual stock auction.

roles.description: An independent orbital livestock rancher; practical, proud of her hardy centrifugal dairy herd, facing financial ruin.
Official livestock registry inspector; cautious, defensive, terrified that genetic fraud will collapse station meat markets.
A speculative trader buying compromised gene-stock at salvage rates to sell to unsuspecting frontier colonies.
The dominant genetic supplier holding the exclusive municipal charter for livestock breeding tanks.
A rotating habitat ring housing three hundred dairy cattle in simulated gravity stalls.
The central agricultural exchange hall where livestock lots are weighed and certified.

public_situation: Bidding opens at {role:auction_terminal} for premium dairy breeding lineages, but whisper campaigns claim the gene-stock is failing.
private_truth: {role:livestock_syndicate} substituted sterile synthetic strains after an unannounced power failure thawed their primary pedigree cryo-vats.

beats.public_change: Herder centrifuges report sudden embryo viability drops while syndicate factors demand upfront non-refundable auction deposits.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to run molecular sensor assays on her sealed embryo vats and document discrepancies in genetic markers.
missions.private_fact: She mortgaged her entire centrifugal ring habitat to purchase the supposedly prize-winning breeding straws.

beats.public_change: Syndicate lawyers file injunctions against independent testing, threatening to impound all uncertified gene-flasks.

missions.reason: She needs industrial liquid nitrogen cooling dewars bought from orbital chemical plants and rushed to her stalls before her remaining viable samples perish.
missions.private_fact: She is keeping three illegal natural-bred calves hidden in the auxiliary water reclamation bay.

beats.public_change: The main breeding auction begins as bidding reaches millions of credits at {role:auction_terminal}.

missions.reason: She needs the verified molecular assay data delivered into the assayer's hands before the auction gavel seals the fraudulent transactions.
missions.private_fact: {role:quiet_broker} is waiting outside the exchange dock with a bag of bearer bonds to buy the corrupted data slate.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the proof that the auction stock is sterile. Three parties offer different outcomes.

options.label: Deliver the assay to the chief assayer to halt the fraudulent auction
Sell the data to the quiet broker and let the auction proceed
Blackmail the syndicate into replacing the herder's stock while burying the wider scandal

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the assay directly to the assayer.
resolutions.summary: The auction is halted in uproar. {role:livestock_syndicate} faces criminal fraud charges, the false stock is seized, and {role:orbital_herder} is vindicated.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed a corrupt agri-syndicate that tried to sell millions in sterile synthetic cattle as prize breeding stock.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the data to the quiet broker.
resolutions.summary: The fraudulent auction concludes. {role:quiet_broker} blackmails syndicate executives, while unsuspecting ranchers take delivery of dead genetics.

consequences.public_summary: Rumors spread of a runner who sold proof of tainted cattle genetics to an offshore arbitrageur for private scrip.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the syndicate into a private settlement.
resolutions.summary: {role:orbital_herder} receives authentic pedigree breeding straws in secret. The fraudulent auction proceeds for everyone else, protecting market confidence.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the mission runs or the coolant is exhausted.
resolutions.summary: The auction clears millions in sales. Months later, thousands of dead embryo vats trigger widespread herd collapses across the frontier.

loose_threads.detail: The central power substation recorded a forty-eight-hour total blackout in the genetic vault that was purged from station maintenance databases.
The syndicate's financial disclosures show a sudden reinsurance claim for thirty million credits filed under an offshore biological loss policy.
The barcode seals on the embryo straws were etched with a hand-held stencil machine rather than the syndicate's certified factory laser.

radio_hooks: Record prices anticipated at the annual System Agricultural Livestock Exposition.
Independent dairy producers protest rising registration fees for certified breeding vats.
Syndicate representatives guarantee genetic purity for all registered embryo shipments.

voice_direction.orbital_herder: Blunt, weary, and smelling of cattle manure. Speaks in practical farming terms, treating livestock bloodlines with the protective pride of an artisan.
voice_direction.pedigree_assayer: Fidgety, nervous, and obsessed with institutional credibility. Speaks in rapid bureaucratic disclaimers to avoid admitting the scales have been compromised.

title: The Orchard Swarm
logline: An orbital fruit arborist races to smuggle clean honeybee hives through an engineered biological quarantine to save her blossoming orchard domes from corporate bankruptcy.

roles.description: Tends thirty hectares of orbital citrus trees; gentle, scholarly, frantic that three generations of heirloom fruit will drop unpollinated.
Station agricultural inspector; cold, pedantic, taking secret stipends from synthetic paste manufacturers to ground live bees.
The alliance of station farmers cultivating fresh produce in competition with industrial protein pastes.
The massive conglomerate that controls synthetic nutrient paste processing across the star system.
A magnificent transparent agricultural bubble filled with blooming orange and lemon trees.
A sealed bio-research station in the outer belt where certified disease-free honeybee colonies are maintained.
The orbital quarantine airlock where all organic agricultural shipments are inspected and fumigated.

public_situation: Automated pollination drones suffer simultaneous software crashes across {system}, leaving citrus orchards on the brink of total failure.
private_truth: {role:synth_food_cartel} bribed {role:quarantine_factor} to declare live honeybee imports bio-hazards, ensuring the orchards fail so the cartel can buy the domes.

beats.public_change: Blossoms begin falling in {role:orchard_dome} as the 48-hour pollination window opens without functional drone swarms.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to collect twenty dormant queen bee hives from the belt apiary before the quarantine factor revokes transit passes.
missions.private_fact: The drone crash was caused by a malicious firmware patch pushed through the cartel's proprietary agricultural network.

beats.public_change: Quarantine officers deploy thermal scanners at {role:customs_checkpoint}, threatening to incinerate any un-certified biological hives.

missions.reason: She needs thermal-insulating dewar casings bought from station supplies to shield the hive crates from automated customs incinerator sensors.
missions.private_fact: She used the orchard's entire emergency reserve fund to buy the insulating casings.

beats.public_change: The quarantine bureau broadcasts notices that the belt apiary was infected with engineered mites, justifying immediate sterilization.

missions.reason: She needs the pilot to scan the checkpoint bio-logs and verify that the mite report was fabricated using forged laboratory test certificates.
missions.private_fact: The arborist's own sister works for the synth-food cartel as a regional marketing director.

beats.public_change: Customs officers move to seize the bee cargo on the docking apron while citrus blossoms wilt inside the domes.

missions.reason: She needs the live hives delivered directly into the orchard canopy before the final floral receptive window closes at sunset.
missions.private_fact: {role:quarantine_factor} is offering fifty thousand credits in synthetic food coupons to surrender the hives for incineration.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands at the orchard airlock with the live bees and the proof of quarantine bribery. Who decides the crop's fate?

options.label: Release the bees into the orchard to pollinate the fruit and expose the cartel
Hand the hives to the quarantine factor for the synthetic food syndicate's payout
Allow the cartel to buy a minority stake in the orchard in exchange for lifting the quarantine

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot releases the bees into the canopy and exposes the fraud.
resolutions.summary: Thousands of bees swarm the citrus trees, saving the harvest. {role:quarantine_factor} is arrested for bribery, and {role:hydroponic_collective} thrives.

consequences.public_summary: A courier smuggled live bees through a corrupt quarantine to save a station's heirloom fruit harvest from corporate saboteurs.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the cartel payout and lets the hives be burned.
resolutions.summary: The hives are destroyed and the blossom crop fails completely. {role:synth_food_cartel} forecloses on {role:orchard_dome}, converting it into protein vats.

consequences.public_summary: Pilots talk of a runner who traded a hold full of rare honeybees to the food monopoly, leaving an orbital orchard to rot.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a corporate minority stake in the farm.
resolutions.summary: The bees are admitted and the crop survives, but {role:synth_food_cartel} acquires fifty percent of the orchard's equity, dictating future prices.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the delivery runs or abandons the contract.
resolutions.summary: The flowers wither without pollination. {role:orchard_arborist} defaults on mortgage debts, and fresh fruit disappears from station markets.

loose_threads.detail: The agricultural market ledger lists a forty-thousand-credit retainer paid to the quarantine inspector by a synthetic food shell corporation.
The corrupted pollination drone code carries a software license watermark owned by the cartel's automated equipment subsidiary.
The quarantine advisory on the apiary was rubber-stamped using the electronic badge of a deceased agricultural inspector.

radio_hooks: Quarantine office issues total ban on transport of live pollinating insects across station docks.
Independent hydroponic collectives warn of imminent fruit shortages if bio-bans continue.
Synthetic food cartel shares surge following reports of orbital orchard blight.

voice_direction.orchard_arborist: Soft, melodic, and deeply passionate about botany. Speaks with the quiet grief of an artist watching a master painting unravel, checking her greenhouse temperature monitors incessantly.
voice_direction.quarantine_factor: Slick, bureaucratic, and condescending. Dismisses living bees as obsolete biological liabilities in a modern spacefaring economy.
